== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ジャワ</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">＊敵味方のフォースデッキから、1フォースずつ消費して、配備する。さもなければ、配備できない。タトゥイーンにのみ配備する。他の星系へ移動することはできる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">口数の多い屑拾い種族。身長1メートル。ジャワ同士で交わす言語は理解不能だが、本当は人間の言葉も話すことができる。巨大な石の砦を築くこともある。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Jawa (Light) (Premiere)]].

'''Lore''' — A talkative scavenger species. Height 1 meter. The language Jawas use with each other is unintelligible, but they can actually speak human language. They sometimes build huge stone fortresses.

'''Game text''' — To deploy, spend 1 Force from each player's Force Deck. Cannot deploy otherwise. Deploy only on Tatooine. May move to other systems.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore calls them talkative (口数の多い), not pesky, and says they can speak human language. English says the trade language is unintelligible unless Jawas wish to be understood. Game text matches the Dark Jawa: Force Deck and other systems.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-jawa.gif|Original English face]], [[Jawa (Light) (Premiere)]].</ref>
